name: Aicher
text: Aicher played music for the Fianna within the Fenian Cycle. The Old Irish sense of his name stays sharp or keen. Aicher takes a small role in the tales. He numbers among the minor musicians of the warrior band.

attributes.attribute: a musician of the Fianna in the Fenian Cycle
a name meaning sharp, fierce, or keen
